skill.displayName: Alibabacloud Cloudbackup Ecs File Backup Essential Edition
skill.summary: Alibaba Cloud ECS File Backup Essential Edition (ECS文件备份基础版). One-click activation, daily automatic backup, 30-day file recovery, 100 GiB free quota. Trigger...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Updated Aliyun CLI minimum required version from 3.3.1 to 3.3.3; now includes installation and update guidance for the CLI.
- Added mandatory usage of a custom User-Agent for every aliyun CLI invocation.
- Introduced AI-Mode pre-check: must enable AI-Mode before any operation, set the User-Agent, and always disable AI-Mode at every exit point.
- Clarified required CLI and plugin update commands to ensure local environment is always up-to-date.
- Expanded installation and pre-check instructions for better accuracy and compliance.
